import importlib.util
import pathlib
import unittest

import torch

SOURCE = pathlib.Path("/fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_c117_global_sinkhorn_poincare/model/hyperbolic.py")
_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("candidate_hyperbolic", SOURCE)
hyperbolic = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(hyperbolic)


class PoincareMathReferenceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_curved_distance_independent_closed_form(self):
        # x=(3/10,4/10), y=(-2/10,1/10): ||x-y||^2=1/2,
        # (1-||x||^2)(1-||y||^2)=(3/4)(19/20)=57/80.
        # Thus arcosh argument is 137/57 and D^2=arcosh(137/57)^2.
        x = torch.tensor([[0.3, 0.4]], dtype=torch.float64)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.2, 0.1]], dtype=torch.float64)
        actual = hyperbolic.squared_distance(x, y, c=1.0)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(actual.item(), 2.321619604582453, places=12)

    def test_exact_flat_limit_and_symmetry(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[0.3, 0.4]], dtype=torch.float64)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.2, 0.1]], dtype=torch.float64)
        # The specified c=0 limit is exactly 4*(1/2)=2/1.
        self.assertAlmostEqual(hyperbolic.squared_distance(x, y, c=0.0).item(), 2.0, places=14)
        curved_xy = hyperbolic.squared_distance(x, y, c=1.0).item()
        curved_yx = hyperbolic.squared_distance(y, x, c=1.0).item()
        self.assertAlmostEqual(curved_xy, curved_yx, places=14)

    def test_coincident_points_have_zero_not_positive_floor(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[0.3, -0.4]], dtype=torch.float64)
        actual = hyperbolic.squared_distance(x, x, c=1.0)
        self.assertEqual(actual.item(), 0.0)

    def test_distance_matrix_matches_pairwise_reference_values(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[0.3, 0.4], [0.0, 0.0]], dtype=torch.float64)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.2, 0.1], [0.3, 0.4]], dtype=torch.float64)
        actual = hyperbolic.squared_distance_matrix(x, y, c=1.0)
        expected = torch.tensor([
            [2.321619604582453, 0.0],
            [1.2069489608125816, 0.0],
        ], dtype=torch.float64)
        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-12)

    def test_projection_uses_closed_fixed_ball(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[3.0, 4.0], [0.3, 0.4]], dtype=torch.float64)
        actual = hyperbolic.project_ball(x, radius=0.9)
        expected = torch.tensor([[0.54, 0.72], [0.3, 0.4]], dtype=torch.float64)
        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0.0, atol=1e-15)
        norms = torch.linalg.vector_norm(actual, dim=-1)
        self.assertTrue(torch.all(norms <= 0.9 + 1e-15).item())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
